taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from MI11.1-3 | Antimicrobial Resistance & Stewardship.

words.clue: This type of resistance is an inherent property present in the organism species before any antibiotic exposure.
This category of resistance is developed through genetic mechanisms such as mutation or horizontal gene transfer.
The horizontal gene transfer mechanism involving direct cell-to-cell plasmid exchange through a sex pilus.
Horizontal gene transfer mechanism where bacteriophages carry resistance genes between bacteria.
Horizontal gene transfer mechanism in which bacteria uptake naked DNA from their environment.
Spontaneous chromosomal alterations like rpoB changes that confer antibiotic resistance in clonal populations.
Circular DNA molecule carrying NDM-1 and other resistance genes that spreads between unrelated bacterial species.
The clear zone surrounding an antibiotic disk on Mueller-Hinton agar where bacterial growth is suppressed.
The gold standard broth-based laboratory method for determining the minimum inhibitory concentration of antibiotics.
Type of pump mechanism in Pseudomonas aeruginosa that contributes to intrinsic antibiotic resistance.
The AST result category when organism is predicted to respond to standard antibiotic dosing.
CLSI or EUCAST cutoff values used to interpret zone diameters and determine resistance status.
